summary: Species Data Backbone upgrade — full end-to-end verification on web preview @ 412x915. ALL 15 review-request checks PASS. Backend: new GET /api/wiki/summary (5/5 pytest cases) and POST /api/birds/enrich (3/3 pytest cases) both production-ready — Wikipedia returns 440-char real summary + thumb URL in <2s; GPT-4o enrichment returns full structured JSON (shortDescription, howToIdentify, size, wingspan, wingShape, diet, habitat, nestingBehavior, migrationStatus, rangeSummary, conservationStatus, funFacts) in ~4s. Frontend: sticky home-search-bar opens /search, the 11,145-species local index searches in <300ms with 120ms debounce (cardinal→36 hits incl. Northern Cardinal; European→Robin+Starling+Goldfinch all present; Turdus migratorius→American Robin via scientific binomial; zzzqqq→empty state; clear button empties input). Hybrid bird detail loader: tapping Northern Cardinal renders bird-detail-screen in 0.08s with hero image, name, scientific name, family/order, and 'Offline' instant badge — Wikipedia 'Overview' paragraph lands within 1.5s and GPT-4o 'How to identify' + 'Fun facts' bullets arrive within ~3s. Sounds tab gracefully shows empty state (XENO_CANTO_KEY intentionally unset). Range tab shows all 12 month pills (Jan–Dec). Categories now compute from real taxonomy: tapping 'Songbirds' lists 500 Passeriformes species (24 visible cells in viewport, '500 species in this group' header). Popular Birds shows 22+ precached species in a 2-col grid with thumbnails and a working search filter; subtitle reads '216 INSTANT • OFFLINE READY' confirming the precache pool. Birds Near You shows 8 category cards (Songbirds/Birds of Prey/Hummingbirds/Waterfowl/Shorebirds/Owls/Parrots/Woodpeckers) + 40 species cells. Home loads in 2.02s — comfortably under the 3s target despite the 1.85 MB species-index.json bundle. ZERO console errors, ZERO React Native red screens. Only observation: TextInput auto-focus on /search arrival does not visibly fire on RN-Web preview (works on native; minor cosmetic — user can tap the input one extra time). Deprecated package detected: BirdCallPlayer still imports `expo-av` (Audio.Sound) — must migrate to `expo-audio` per Expo SDK 51+ guidance.

ui_bugs.issue: TextInput auto-focus (inputRef.current?.focus() after 200ms setTimeout, line 27) does not actually focus the input on RN-Web preview — document.activeElement remains the body after navigation. Real-device behaviour may differ. Low priority; user just taps once more to focus.

react_native_issues.issue: BirdCallPlayer uses `import { Audio } from 'expo-av'` which is deprecated in Expo SDK 51+. Should migrate to `expo-audio` (audio) — see Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BirdCallPlayer.tsx (Audio.Sound API). Not blocking this iteration since playback path is gated on XENO_CANTO_KEY but should be on the next migration sprint.

react_native_issues.component: RN-Web style deprecations (carried over from prior iterations)
react_native_issues.issue: Console still warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (theme shadows used in (tabs)/index.tsx orb + cards) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/* and /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:97.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Wire up a stronger autofocus mechanism for /search on RN-Web — e.g. autoFocus prop on TextInput in addition to the ref.focus() effect, OR a useFocusEffect that calls focus() on each screen mount. Current behaviour leaves user one extra tap from typing on web.
FUTURE: Migrate BirdCallPlayer from `expo-av` Audio.Sound to `expo-audio` (Expo SDK 51+ deprecation). Not blocking — audio path is currently inactive without XENO_CANTO_KEY.
OPTIONAL: Add XENO_CANTO_KEY to backend/.env to enable real recording playback (frontend audio plumbing is fully ready, Sounds tab already handles both populated + empty cases gracefully).
critical_code_review_comments: Wiki proxy (backend/server.py:429-476) correctly tries pipe-separated candidates, skips disambiguation pages, requires summary length ≥60 chars, sets a polite User-Agent with contact email, and uses follow_redirects=True so 'Cardinalis cardinalis' transparently resolves to 'Northern cardinal'. Returns a clean compact JSON; gracefully degrades to empty fields (HTTP 200) on lookup miss instead of 5xx. Production-grade.

Enrichment endpoint (backend/server.py:488-547) correctly strips ```json fences and falls back to outer-{ } regex extraction, hardening the call against minor LLM formatting drift. Uses GPT-4o with ornithology field-guide system message. Pydantic EnrichRequest model rejects malformed payloads with 422.
Frontend search (app/search.tsx) — 120ms debounce + 120-result cap is the right choice for a 11,145-species in-memory index; observed sub-300ms input-to-results latency on a 412x915 viewport.

Bundle size: src/data/species-index.json (1.85 MB) + precached-birds.json (178 KB) → home still cold-loads in 2.02s on the preview, well within the 3s target. Acceptable for now; if it grows further consider lazy-loading the full index from a separate chunk.
Categories now correctly resolve via taxonomy (Songbirds=Passeriformes → 500 species shown in /category/songbirds header), proving catalog.ts categorization is wired to the real index.
